name: Earth breaker
source: Ultimate Equipment pg. 18, Rise of the Runelords Player's Guide pg. 11, Curse of the Crimson Throne Player's Guide pg. 13, Pathfinder Campaign Setting pg. 209, Inner Sea World Guid
body:
Source Ultimate Equipment pg. 18, Rise of the Runelords Player's Guide pg. 11, Curse of the Crimson Throne Player's Guide pg. 13, Pathfinder Campaign Setting pg. 209, Inner Sea World Guide pg. 290, Adventurer's Armory pg. 0, Varisia, Birthplace of Legends pg. 14
Statistics
Cost 40 gp Weight 14 lbs.
Damage 1d10 (small), 2d6 (medium); Critical x3; Range —; Type B; Special —
Category Two-Handed; Proficiency Martial
Weapon Groups Hammers
Description
The crude metal of this massive hammer’s head ends in multiple blunt spikes that help concentrate the force of a powerful swing down into a smaller, more focused area, allowing it to smash through armor with greater ease. Due to the tremendous size and weight of its head, an earth breaker is poorly balanced, and requires two hands to properly lift and control.
